metadata.title: Retracted papers and their open citation neighbourhoods: Retraction Watch labels linked to the OpenCitations graph (January 2024)
metadata.description:
Retraction labels and open citation links for the paper Do links to retracted papers predict future retractions? An out-of-sample test on the open biomedical citation graph (H. Mohasel Arjomandi, submitted).

Files

  • retracted_papers.csv.gz (62,735 rows): every paper with a retraction in the Retraction Watch database (copy of 30 October 2026, repository commit a98cc7e): DOI, PMID, date of the first retraction notice, publication year, paper-mill flag, Retraction Watch reasons and article type, the matching OpenCitations OMIDs, and whether the paper is in the January 2024 OpenCitations graph (52,254 are).
  • citation_edges.csv.gz (2,259,192 rows): every citation in the OpenCitations snapshot of January 2024 in which the citing or the cited paper is retracted, with OMID, DOI, PMID and publication year at both ends.
  • communities.csv.gz (2,698,556 rows): Leiden community memberships (two seeds) for the subgraph used in the paper's concentration analysis.
  • README.md and SHA256SUMS.

Time split. Retraction dates let users choose any time point T: papers retracted by T are known, later ones are outcomes. The graph is essentially complete to about September 2023.

Not included, by design. No author names, titles or notes, and no score or ranking of non-retracted papers. A retraction is a public editorial label and does not by itself imply misconduct.

Sources. OpenCitations (parsed snapshot, Illinois Data Bank, doi:10.13012/B2IDB-5216575_V1, CC BY 4.0); OpenCitations Meta (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.21747461.v7, CC0); Retraction Watch database distributed by Crossref (please cite the source); PubMed identifiers courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine (may not reflect the latest NLM data).

Code, pre-registration and run records: https://github.com/HosseinMA96/retracted-neighbours-open-data
metadata.notes: Derived from public sources; see README.md for definitions. Retraction labels follow the Retraction Watch database.
